name: computer_core_2
title: Computer Core 2 (ALPHA)
author: SirEdvin; original Computer Core by Relik77 and contributors
description: EXPERIMENTAL 0.4.0 ALPHA PLAYTEST - blue computers now have a native multiline editor, restricted event-driven Lua scripts and owned left/right circuit ports with an editable stock-controller example. No arbitrary Lua, modules, VM fallback or world/network access on blue. Original/personal VM computers retain Recrafted shell/editors. Both models use existing computer research. Graphical input/rendering and multiplayer joins remain unverified. Back up saves and never downgrade a migrated save. Expect bugs and API changes.
